test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a role played by NITI Aayog in the localisation of SDGs in India?

options.text: Fostering competitive federalism among states and UTs
Benchmarking states based on SDG performance metrics
Serving as a platform for collaboration among states

solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• NITI Aayog does not prepare the National Indicator Framework (NIF); this task is primarily undertaken by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI).
 
• The NIF is crucial for monitoring the progress of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and is developed in consultation with various stakeholders, including government bodies, international agencies, and civil society organizations.
 
• NITI Aayog plays a significant role in fostering competitive federalism by encouraging states and Union Territories (UTs) to actively participate in achieving SDG targets.
 
• Benchmarking states based on SDG performance metrics is another crucial function of NITI Aayog, helping to identify areas that need improvement and promoting best practices.
 
• NITI Aayog serves as a collaborative platform for states and UTs, facilitating the exchange of ideas and strategies to achieve the SDGs effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**

 
 
• The SDGs are a set of 17 global goals adopted by all United Nations Member States in 2015 as part of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
 
• The goals cover a broad range of social, economic, and environmental development issues.
 
• They aim to end poverty, protect the planet, and ensure prosperity for all.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog:**
 
 
• The National Institution for Transforming India, known as NITI Aayog, is a policy think-tank of the Government of India, established with the aim to achieve sustainable development goals.
 
• It was formed on January 1, 2015, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
• NITI Aayog promotes cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the states.
 
 
 
• **National Indicator Framework (NIF):**
 
 
• The NIF is designed to track the progress of SDG targets in India.
 
• It includes a comprehensive set of indicators that are periodically reviewed and updated.
 
• The framework helps in identifying data gaps and areas that require policy intervention.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI):**
 
 
• MoSPI is responsible for the development and maintenance of statistical standards and the coordination of statistical activities in India.
 
• It is the nodal agency for the preparation of the National Indicator Framework.
 
• MoSPI ensures the availability of reliable, timely, and credible data for policymakers and stakeholders.
